definitions.gloss: a person who loves sweets; someone with a sweet tooth
definitions.explanation: a person who prefers sweet foods and desserts, especially as opposed to alcohol

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{甘党|あまとう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧。
examples.english: I have a sweet tooth, so I love cake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{甘党|あまとう}で、⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: My father has a sweet tooth and prefers Japanese sweets to alcohol.

examples.japanese: {甘党|あまとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦スイーツ→スイーツ：27370_suiitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new dessert perfect for people with a sweet tooth has been released.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧ (sweet) + {党|とう} (party, group) → sweet party/group

The {党|とう} suffix indicates belonging to a preference group.

CONTRAST WITH {辛党|からとう}:
Originally, {甘党|あまとう} vs ⟦{辛党|からとう}→辛党：08340_karatou⟧ was about sweets vs alcohol (not spicy food):
- {甘党|あまとう}: prefers sweets, doesn't drink much
- ⟦{辛党|からとう}→辛党：08340_karatou⟧: prefers drinking alcohol

However, modern usage sometimes interprets ⟦{辛党|からとう}→辛党：08340_karatou⟧ as someone who likes spicy food.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの{好|ず}き (lover of sweet things)
- ⟦スイーツ→スイーツ：27370_suiitsu⟧{好|ず}き (dessert lover)
